title: Binance P2P Express Supports Binance Alpha Tokens Direct Purchases with Local Currencies and Payment Methods
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, Binance is thrilled to announce that users can now use the "P2P Hot Token Converter" to  seamlessly acquire any Binance Alpha token via the P2P Express zone  on the Binance App. Benefits: Acquire trending Binance Alpha tokens using your preferred local currency and payment method; Seize trading opportunities with Binance Launchpool and stay close to the hottest market trend; Enjoy the convenience of purchasing tokens without needing to use different blockchains or hold crypto. Earn Binance Alpha Points based on your purchase volume of Binance Alpha tokens, making you eligible to participate in an exclusive Token Generation Event (TGE) or claim an Alpha airdrop. How It Works: Head to  Binance P2P Express  on your Binance App.  Choose the Binance Alpha token you wish to buy and select your preferred payment method. Complete payment to purchase USDT or USDC and the system will automatically convert the USDT into your selected Alpha token. You will then receive the Binance Alpha token directly in your Alpha Wallet. * Please note that this feature is only available on the Binance App. For the best experience, users can upgrade their App to 2.101.4 or higher for Android, or 2.101.1 or higher for iOS. For More Information:  How to Buy Hot Tokens via Binance P2P Express Note: There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-18
